entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This whole process has been a disaster and I'm frankly out of patience.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
A preference? The color is completely wrong! It looked one way on your website, and it's this hideous neon shade in person. It’s still in the box, completely unopened. I haven’t even touched it.

I understand the frustration when an item's color isn't quite what you expected. Our helmets are designed with high-visibility pigments for rider safety, which can sometimes appear differently under various lighting conditions—

I don't need a lecture on safety or pigments! Are you going to process this return or not? I'm looking at my order, it was delivered 29 days ago. I want my money back. Get me your manager if you can't handle this. I am one second away from writing a review that will make your whole company look like a joke.

No, no, that won't be necessary. I understand your urgency. Let me just pull up your account and our policy. One moment... Okay, I see your order here for the helmet. Since it was delivered 29 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this for you right now.
Finally. Took you long enough. So what's next?

I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Since you mentioned the box is unopened, you can just attach that label directly to it and drop it off at any designated shipping partner.

Once our warehouse receives the helmet, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. That typically takes 3 to 5 business days to reflect in your account after we've received the item.
Fine. Just make sure that email actually shows up.
It has been sent. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
